title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions for Certified Reachability of Learning-Enabled Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.23246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nearly all current methods for computing reachable sets of nonlinear dynamics propagate them with truncated Taylor expansions plus rigorous remainders. The expansion is pointwise: once its argument is a whole set rather than a point, one polynomial must stay accurate across that set, and it reaches only as far as its disc of convergence. The limit binds hardest on the rational terms and sigmoid gates of modern controllers: smooth as these look on the real line, in the complex plane they blow up at points just off the real axis, closer as a gate sharpens, and those points cap the set width a Taylor expansion can cover, most tightly on the switching surface where the controller decides. We prove a dichotomy: no Taylor degree certifies sets wider than that cap, while a Chebyshev abstraction of equal degree, anchored to the whole set in the same polynomial-zonotope pipeline, has no cap and gains width at a geometric rate in degree. Measured

translated_title: 面向学习使能系统认证可达性的切比雪夫多项式带状体抽象
translated_abstract: 当前几乎所有计算非线性动力学可达集的方法都采用截断泰勒展开并附加严格余项来进行传播。这种展开是逐点的：一旦其自变量是整个集合而非单个点，一个多项式就必须在整个集合上保持精确，而其覆盖范围仅限于自身的收敛圆盘之内。这一限制在现代控制器的有理项与Sigmoid门控函数上体现得最为严苛：尽管这些函数在实轴上看似光滑，但在复平面上它们会在紧邻实轴的奇点处发散，且门控越尖锐、奇点越靠近实轴，这些奇点便限制了泰勒展开所能覆盖的集合宽度，而这一限制在控制器做出切换决策的切换面上最为紧迫。我们证明了一个二分性结论：任何阶数的泰勒展开都无法认证宽度超过该上限的集合，而同等阶数的切比雪夫抽象，在同一多项式带状体流水线中锚定于整个集合，则不存在该上限，其可覆盖宽度随阶数呈几何级数增长。实测……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明泰勒展开因复平面上紧邻实轴的奇点而存在不可逾越的可达集宽度上限，并提出基于切比雪夫多项式带状体的抽象方法，在同等阶数下不受该上限约束且认证宽度随阶数呈几何级数增长，从而实现对学习使能系统更精确的认证可达性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Taylor-based reachability is capped by complex-plane singularities near the real axis, and proposes Chebyshev polynomial-zonotope abstractions that, at equal degree, have no such cap and gain certified set width at a geometric rate, enabling certified reachability of learning-enabled systems.
